text: This guide helps you update your address after youmove into a new apartment. It’s not automatic.

section: Put your name on your mailbox
text: German apartments rarely have apartment numbers. Mailboxes and doorbells have no numbers, just names. To receive your mail, your name must be on your mailbox. How to put your name on the mailbox

Every time you move, you mustregister your addressat theBürgeramt. During yourAnmeldungappointment, they put a new address sticker on your passport,personal ID,residence permitandvehicle registration papers.6 How to register your address

When you move, you must change your address in these places: BankIf you leave Germany,keep your bank account. You will still need it. EmployerYour employer might need to send you documents, even if youquit your jobor leave Germany. Health insuranceUse your health insurer’s online portal. If you leave Germany, you cancancel your health insurance. Other insurersIf you stay in Germany, you usually stay insured at your new address, but the price can change. If you leave Germany,cancel your insurance contracts. Electricity or gas companyRead your electricity meterbefore you move out. You usually keep the same contract at your new address. If they can’t serve your new address, you can end your contract.7 Agentur für Arbeitif you getALG I Beitragsservicefor theTV tax FinanzamtDo it online inELSTER, ask yourtax advisorto do it, or email your oldFinanzamt.8 Jobcenterif you getGrundsicherung JugendamtIf your children go toKita,get a new Kitagutschein. Hunderegisterif you have a dogOrdnungsamtif your dog is adangerous breed Ordnungsamtif your dog is adangerous breed Kfz-Zulassungsstelleif you have vehiclesThey will put a sticker with your new address on yourZulassungsbescheinigung.3They can do it during yourAnmeldung. If you forgot your vehicle papers,do it online, or at theKfz-Zulassungsstelle. Useumziehen.deto tell companies your new address for free. They only share your new address with businesses that know your old address. You do not need to tell theAusländerbehörde. When you do yourAnmeldung, theBürgeramtshares your new address. They also put a sticker with your new address on yourresidence permit.6

To change your business address, you must update your address in these places: FinanzamtDo it online inELSTER, ask yourtax advisorto do it, or email yourFinanzamt.2If your new address is served by a differentFinanzamt, you will get a newSteuernummer.1 Ordnungsamt or Gewerbeamt(if you have aGewerbe) Künstlersozialkasse(if you are a member) Your website’sImpressum Your invoices

You might still receive letters at your old address. You can ask theDeutsche Postto forward mail to your new address. It’s called aNachsendeantrag. It costs €31.90for 6 months. Forward your mail Mail forwarding isnot reliable. Official mail from theBürgeramt,Finanzamt,AusländerbehördeandAgentur für Arbeitis rarely forwarded.4Forwarded mail can take a week longer to arrive.5Packages are not forwarded.
